words.enDefinition: Weather likely to cause significant hazards or disruption in an area

examples.en: The library announced different hours because of severe weather in the area.
examples.zh: 由于当地有「恶劣天气」，图书馆公布了调整后的开放时间。

examples.en: The museum cited severe weather when it moved the workshop indoors.
examples.zh: 博物馆把讲座移到室内时，提到了「恶劣天气」。

words.enDefinition: An official message about potentially hazardous weather affecting an area

examples.en: I received a weather alert while waiting for my afternoon class.
examples.zh: 我在等下午上课时收到了一条「天气警报」。

examples.en: The weather alert named the counties covered by the latest forecast.
examples.zh: 「天气警报」列出了最新预报涵盖的几个县。

collocations: a weather alert for the area

words.enDefinition: A US alert indicating that conditions favor a specified weather hazard

examples.en: The US forecast explained what the weather watch meant for this area.
examples.zh: 美国的预报解释了这条「天气监视通报」对本地区意味着什么。

examples.en: The campus linked to a weather watch in its afternoon update.
examples.zh: 学校在下午的更新中附上了一条「天气监视通报」的链接。

collocations: a weather watch for the region

words.enDefinition: An official alert for dangerous weather occurring or expected in an area

examples.en: I checked whether the weather warning included the town where I lived.
examples.zh: 我查了一下，「危险天气警告」是否涵盖我住的小镇。

examples.en: The supervisor mentioned the weather warning when announcing the change of venue.
examples.zh: 主管宣布更改地点时，提到了「危险天气警告」。

collocations: a weather warning for heavy rain

words.enDefinition: A US notification about potentially disruptive conditions below a warning level

examples.en: I asked which symbol indicated a weather advisory on the US map.
examples.zh: 我问美国地图上哪个标志代表「天气注意提示」。

examples.en: The weather advisory explained which roads might be affected by the snow.
examples.zh: 「天气注意提示」说明了哪些道路可能受降雪影响。

collocations: a weather advisory for the area

words.enDefinition: An official notice highlighting unusual or potentially disruptive weather conditions

examples.en: The Canadian forecast linked to a special weather statement for our region.
examples.zh: 加拿大的预报附上了本地区「特别天气说明」的链接。

examples.en: I noticed a special weather statement above the regular forecast for tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我注意到，明天的常规预报上方有一份「特别天气说明」。

collocations: details in a special weather statement

words.enDefinition: A US forecast summary describing possible weather hazards ahead

examples.en: The hazardous weather outlook covered the days of our planned student trip.
examples.zh: 「危险天气展望」涵盖了我们计划出游的那几天。

examples.en: The event page linked to a hazardous weather outlook for the region.
examples.zh: 活动页面附上了本地区「危险天气展望」的链接。

collocations: hazards in the hazardous weather outlook

words.enDefinition: An official written or broadcast update on current weather conditions

examples.en: I read the weather bulletin before looking at the campus schedule.
examples.zh: 我先读了「天气公报」，再去看校园安排。

examples.en: The weather bulletin said the strongest winds were expected near the coast.
examples.zh: 「天气公报」说，最强的风预计出现在沿海地带。

collocations: a weather bulletin from the forecaster

words.enDefinition: The geographic area covered by a particular official warning

examples.en: I checked whether our campus was inside the warning area on the map.
examples.zh: 我查看了地图上的「警告覆盖区域」是否包括我们学校。

examples.en: The warning area was outlined in color on the official forecast page.
examples.zh: 官方预报网页用彩色线条划出了「警告覆盖区域」。

words.enDefinition: A place experiencing a weather hazard or a service interruption

examples.en: The provider added our street to the affected area on its map.
examples.zh: 服务商在地图上把我们这条街加入了「受影响区域」。

examples.en: The notice gave separate information for each affected area near campus.
examples.zh: 通知分别列出了学校附近各个「受影响区域」的情况。

words.enDefinition: A rating of the disruption or harm expected from a hazard

examples.en: The bulletin showed the impact level beside the expected start time.
examples.zh: 公报在预计开始时间旁标出了「影响程度」。

examples.en: I asked what the impact level meant for local bus services.
examples.zh: 我问这个「影响程度」对本地公交服务意味着什么。

collocations: an impact level in a warning

words.enDefinition: A UK weather alert typically indicating possible disruptions or impacts

examples.en: The UK map showed a yellow weather warning over our county.
examples.zh: 英国的地图显示我们这个郡有一条「黄色天气警告」。

examples.en: I checked the text of the yellow weather warning before reading the route notices.
examples.zh: 我先看了「黄色天气警告」的内容，再看线路通知。

collocations: a yellow weather warning for rain

words.enDefinition: A UK weather alert indicating increased risk of serious impacts

examples.en: The college mentioned an amber weather warning when postponing our field visit.
examples.zh: 学院推迟实地考察时，提到了「琥珀色天气警告」。

examples.en: The UK forecast put the amber weather warning beside a map of expected impacts.
examples.zh: 英国预报把「琥珀色天气警告」放在预计影响地图旁边。

collocations: an amber weather warning is in force
an amber weather warning for strong winds

words.enDefinition: The highest UK weather warning level for expected severe impacts

examples.en: The UK bulletin displayed a red weather warning for the coastal district.
examples.zh: 英国公报为沿海地区发布了「红色天气警告」。

examples.en: I read which areas were covered by the red weather warning on that day.
examples.zh: 我读了当天的「红色天气警告」，确认它覆盖哪些地方。

collocations: a red weather warning in force
areas covered by a red weather warning

words.enDefinition: Words indicating a weather warning currently applies to an area

examples.en: The forecast showed "Warning in effect" above the map of our town.
examples.zh: 预报在我们镇的地图上方显示「警告生效中」。

examples.en: The official map listed one warning in effect beside our district name.
examples.zh: 官方地图在本区名称旁标出了一条「警告生效中」的信息。

collocations: a warning in effect for the region
a warning in effect through the afternoon

words.enDefinition: Words introducing the expected end time of an active alert

examples.en: The page said the warning was in effect until that evening.
examples.zh: 页面写明，该警告「持续生效至」当天晚上。

examples.en: I saw "In effect until tomorrow" beneath the map and checked the date.
examples.zh: 我在地图下看到「持续生效至明天」，就核对了日期。

collocations: a warning in effect until noon

words.enDefinition: An alert update indicating a warning's stated duration increased

examples.en: I saw "Warning extended" beside the revised times on the forecast page.
examples.zh: 我在预报页面调整后的时间旁看见「警告延长」。

examples.en: The evening bulletin said "Warning extended" and listed a later end time.
examples.zh: 晚间公报写着「警告延长」，并列出了更晚的结束时间。

words.enDefinition: An update indicating that a weather warning no longer applies

examples.en: The map said "Warning lifted" next to the city name that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午，地图在城市名称旁显示「警告已解除」。

examples.en: I saw "Warning lifted" before the library posted its revised hours.
examples.zh: 图书馆发布调整后的时间前，我先看到了「警告已解除」。

words.enDefinition: An update indicating a reduction in the alert's severity level

examples.en: The page said "Warning downgraded" beside the newest entry for the coast.
examples.zh: 页面在沿海地区最新一条消息旁写着「警告级别已降低」。

examples.en: The warning downgraded message appeared below a link to the new advisory.
examples.zh: 「警告级别已降低」的消息出现在新提示链接下方。

words.enDefinition: An update indicating elevation to a more serious warning level

examples.en: The bulletin said "Warning upgraded" and linked to a fresh map.
examples.zh: 公报写着「警告级别已提高」，并附上最新地图的链接。

examples.en: The warning upgraded status appeared while our group was reading the updates.
examples.zh: 我们小组在看更新时，页面显示「警告级别已提高」。

words.enDefinition: An earlier warning replaced by a newer issue or update

examples.en: I compared the superseded warning with the latest one on the map.
examples.zh: 我把「已被替代的警告」与地图上最新的警告作了比较。

examples.en: The archive kept the superseded warning beside the earlier forecast notes.
examples.zh: 存档把「已被替代的警告」和此前的预报记录放在一起。

words.enDefinition: The extent to which forecasters are sure about a prediction

examples.en: The forecast confidence differed between the morning and afternoon updates.
examples.zh: 早间和下午更新所示的「预报置信度」不同。

examples.en: The bulletin showed forecast confidence separately from the expected impact.
examples.zh: 公报把「预报置信度」与预计影响分开显示。

words.enDefinition: The possibility that normal services or activities will be interrupted

examples.en: The campus notice mentioned a risk of disruption to afternoon transport.
examples.zh: 学校的通知提到下午交通存在「服务受扰风险」。

examples.en: I read which services had a risk of disruption during the storm.
examples.zh: 我查看了暴风雨期间哪些服务有「服务受扰风险」。

collocations: warn of a risk of disruption

words.enDefinition: An official alert about rain expected to fall heavily

examples.en: The forecast page showed a heavy rainfall warning over the region.
examples.zh: 预报页面在本地区显示了一条「强降雨警告」。

examples.en: The campus schedule mentioned a heavy rainfall warning in its update.
examples.zh: 校园日程更新中提到了一条「强降雨警告」。

collocations: remain under a heavy rainfall warning

words.enDefinition: An official alert that particularly strong winds are expected or occurring

examples.en: The US notice gave the start time of the high wind warning.
examples.zh: 美国通知写明了「强风警告」的开始时间。

examples.en: The library's closure note mentioned a high wind warning in the district.
examples.zh: 图书馆的闭馆通知提到这一地区有「强风警告」。

collocations: areas under a high wind warning

words.enDefinition: A US alert that significant winter storm conditions are possible

examples.en: The winter storm watch covered the time of our planned train journey.
examples.zh: 「冬季风暴监视通报」涵盖了我们计划坐火车的时间。

examples.en: I checked which counties were listed in the winter storm watch before class.
examples.zh: 上课前，我核对了「冬季风暴监视通报」列出的县。

collocations: a winter storm watch for the area
a county under a winter storm watch

words.enDefinition: A US alert for significant winter storm conditions expected or occurring

examples.en: The county was under a winter storm warning when campus hours changed.
examples.zh: 学校调整开放时间时，该县处于「冬季风暴警告」范围内。

examples.en: The winter storm warning mentioned both snow and possible ice on roads.
examples.zh: 「冬季风暴警告」提到了降雪和道路可能结冰。

collocations: areas under a winter storm warning

words.enDefinition: A US alert for disruptive winter weather below warning severity

examples.en: I saw a winter weather advisory before reading the library's opening hours.
examples.zh: 我在看图书馆开放时间之前，看到了一条「冬季天气注意提示」。

examples.en: The forecast explained which roads were covered by the winter weather advisory.
examples.zh: 预报说明了「冬季天气注意提示」涵盖哪些道路。

collocations: a winter weather advisory for snow
an area under a winter weather advisory

words.enDefinition: A US alert for expected or ongoing blizzard conditions

examples.en: The blizzard warning gave details about poor visibility on nearby roads.
examples.zh: 「暴风雪警告」说明了附近道路能见度较差的情况。

examples.en: The university cited a blizzard warning in its class cancellation notice.
examples.zh: 学校在停课通知中提到了一条「暴风雪警告」。

collocations: an area under a blizzard warning

words.enDefinition: An official alert for thunderstorms expected to produce dangerous conditions

examples.en: The severe thunderstorm warning was posted while our workshop was still running.
examples.zh: 我们的讲座还在进行时，发布了一条「强雷暴警告」。

examples.en: I checked which towns the severe thunderstorm warning covered near the coast.
examples.zh: 我查看了「强雷暴警告」涵盖沿海哪些城镇。

collocations: an area under a severe thunderstorm warning

words.enDefinition: A US alert indicating conditions are favorable for tornado formation

examples.en: The US forecast listed a tornado watch for our county.
examples.zh: 美国预报列出了我们所在县的「龙卷风监视通报」。

examples.en: Our college mentioned the tornado watch in an afternoon bulletin.
examples.zh: 学院在下午的公报中提到了「龙卷风监视通报」。

collocations: a tornado watch for the region

words.enDefinition: A US alert that a tornado has been observed or indicated

examples.en: The tornado warning named the towns in its projected path.
examples.zh: 「龙卷风警告」列出了预计路径上的城镇。

examples.en: I read the tornado warning while checking the university service page.
examples.zh: 我查看学校服务页面时，也看了「龙卷风警告」。

collocations: an area under a tornado warning

words.enDefinition: A US alert indicating hurricane conditions are possible in an area

examples.en: The forecast added our coastal county to the hurricane watch.
examples.zh: 预报把我们所在的沿海县加入了「飓风监视通报」范围。

examples.en: The local ferry notice mentioned a hurricane watch for the coastline.
examples.zh: 本地渡轮通知提到沿岸有一条「飓风监视通报」。

collocations: a county under a hurricane watch

words.enDefinition: A US alert indicating hurricane conditions are expected in an area

examples.en: The hurricane warning appeared above the ferry operator's closure message.
examples.zh: 「飓风警告」显示在渡轮运营方的停运消息上方。

examples.en: The county bulletin referred to the hurricane warning in its opening paragraph.
examples.zh: 县里的公报在开头一段提到了「飓风警告」。

collocations: an area under a hurricane warning

words.enDefinition: A US alert indicating tropical storm conditions are expected

examples.en: The website linked to a tropical storm warning for the islands.
examples.zh: 网站附上了群岛地区的「热带风暴警告」链接。

examples.en: The tropical storm warning named the districts in the affected area.
examples.zh: 「热带风暴警告」列出了受影响地区的各个区。

collocations: a tropical storm warning for the coast
an area under a tropical storm warning

words.enDefinition: An Australian alert for areas expected to experience cyclone conditions

examples.en: The Australian tropical cyclone warning covered several towns along the coastline.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚这条「热带气旋警告」涵盖了沿海几个城镇。

examples.en: The ferry operator referred to the tropical cyclone warning in its update.
examples.zh: 渡轮运营方在更新中提到了「热带气旋警告」。

collocations: an area under a tropical cyclone warning

words.enDefinition: A US alert about expected coastal flooding from rising sea water

examples.en: The storm surge warning named the ports inside the coastal warning area.
examples.zh: 「风暴潮警告」列出了沿海警告区内的港口。

examples.en: The ferry operator linked to the storm surge warning beside its timetable.
examples.zh: 渡轮运营方在时刻表旁附上了「风暴潮警告」链接。

collocations: a storm surge warning for the coast
an area under a storm surge warning

words.enDefinition: A US alert indicating conditions may cause flooding in an area

examples.en: The flood watch included the district where my study group met.
examples.zh: 「洪水监视通报」涵盖了学习小组碰面的那个区。

examples.en: The adviser checked the flood watch before changing the field trip date.
examples.zh: 顾问先看了「洪水监视通报」，再调整实地考察的日期。

collocations: a flood watch for low areas
a county under a flood watch

words.enDefinition: A US alert for rapid flooding expected or already occurring

examples.en: The flash flood warning mentioned rapid flooding along a low stretch of road.
examples.zh: 「突发洪水警告」提到一处低洼路段迅速被水淹没。

examples.en: The county put a flash flood warning above its road closure updates.
examples.zh: 县里把「突发洪水警告」放在道路封闭信息上方。

collocations: an area under a flash flood warning

words.enDefinition: An official alert for a river expected to reach flood levels

examples.en: The river flood warning named the river by our field station.
examples.zh: 「河流洪水警告」点到了野外工作站旁边那条河。

examples.en: The map marked areas covered by the river flood warning in blue.
examples.zh: 地图用蓝色标出了「河流洪水警告」涵盖的地区。

collocations: a river flood warning for a basin
a river under a river flood warning

words.enDefinition: A US alert about expected coastal flooding below warning severity

examples.en: The coastal flood advisory showed where water might reach low roads.
examples.zh: 「沿海洪水注意提示」说明了海水可能漫到哪些低洼道路。

examples.en: The city mentioned the coastal flood advisory in a waterfront update.
examples.zh: 市政府在滨水区动态里提到了「沿海洪水注意提示」。

collocations: a coastal flood advisory for the shore
an area under a coastal flood advisory

words.enDefinition: An official alert for dangerously cold temperatures or wind chill

examples.en: The extreme cold warning appeared beside the revised bus service hours.
examples.zh: 「极寒警告」出现在调整后的公交运营时间旁边。

examples.en: The college referred to an extreme cold warning in its morning message.
examples.zh: 学院在早间消息中提到了一条「极寒警告」。

collocations: an area under an extreme cold warning

words.enDefinition: An official alert for dangerous heat expected or already occurring

examples.en: The extreme heat warning was listed above the switch to indoor events.
examples.zh: 举行室内活动的调整说明上方列出了「极端高温警告」。

examples.en: The city included the extreme heat warning in its announcement about park hours.
examples.zh: 市政府在公告公园开放时间时提到了「极端高温警告」。

collocations: an area under an extreme heat warning

words.enDefinition: A US alert for potentially hazardous heat below warning severity

examples.en: The campus cited a heat advisory when changing the event venue.
examples.zh: 学校更改活动地点时提到了一条「高温注意提示」。

examples.en: I saw the heat advisory above the regular afternoon forecast.
examples.zh: 我在常规下午预报上方看到了「高温注意提示」。

collocations: a heat advisory for the area
a county under a heat advisory

words.enDefinition: A US alert for expected disruptive ice accumulation from freezing rain

examples.en: The ice storm warning mentioned ice building up on roads and branches.
examples.zh: 「冰暴警告」提到了道路和树枝上结冰的情况。

examples.en: I read the ice storm warning before checking the shuttle timetable.
examples.zh: 我先看了「冰暴警告」，然后查看班车时刻表。

collocations: an area under an ice storm warning

words.enDefinition: A US alert that thick fog is reducing visibility

examples.en: The dense fog advisory appeared beside the bridge's revised opening times.
examples.zh: 「浓雾注意提示」出现在大桥调整后的开放时间旁。

examples.en: The forecast linked to a dense fog advisory covering the valley.
examples.zh: 预报附上了谷地「浓雾注意提示」的链接。

collocations: a dense fog advisory for the coast
an area under a dense fog advisory

words.enDefinition: A US warning that weather conditions favor dangerous fire activity

examples.en: The US county mentioned a Red Flag Warning in its park update.
examples.zh: 美国的这个县在公园动态中提到了一条「美国火险红旗警告」。

examples.en: The forecaster posted a Red Flag Warning on the fire weather map.
examples.zh: 预报人员在火险天气地图上发布了一条「美国火险红旗警告」。

collocations: an area under a Red Flag Warning

words.enDefinition: A US alert that critical conditions for wildfire may develop

examples.en: The fire weather watch covered the area near our field station.
examples.zh: 「火险天气监视通报」涵盖了我们野外工作站附近的区域。

examples.en: I checked whether the park was listed under the fire weather watch.
examples.zh: 我查了这座公园是否列在「火险天气监视通报」范围内。

collocations: a fire weather watch for the area
a county under a fire weather watch

words.enDefinition: A notice that smoke from wildfires is affecting air quality

examples.en: The city posted a wildfire smoke advisory with its outdoor venue update.
examples.zh: 市政府更新室外场地信息时发布了「野火烟霾注意提示」。

examples.en: Our campus bulletin linked to the wildfire smoke advisory for the valley.
examples.zh: 学校的公报附上了谷地「野火烟霾注意提示」的链接。

collocations: areas in a wildfire smoke advisory

words.enDefinition: Rain that freezes after coming into contact with cold surfaces

examples.en: The forecast listed freezing rain before the temperature dropped that evening.
examples.zh: 当晚气温下降之前，预报已列出可能出现「冻雨」。

examples.en: The maintenance report described ice left by freezing rain on the walkways.
examples.zh: 维护报告描述了人行道上因「冻雨」留下的冰。

words.enDefinition: A thin, hard-to-see layer of ice on paved surfaces

examples.en: The local road notice mentioned black ice on the bridge.
examples.zh: 本地道路通知提到桥面上有「路面透明薄冰」。

examples.en: Our campus map marked a path affected by black ice.
examples.zh: 校园地图标出了一条受「路面透明薄冰」影响的小路。

words.enDefinition: How cold the air feels due to temperature and wind

examples.en: The forecast displayed wind chill separately from the air temperature.
examples.zh: 预报把「风寒体感」和实际气温分开显示。

examples.en: I read the note about wind chill in the morning forecast.
examples.zh: 我看了早间预报里有关「风寒体感」的说明。

words.enDefinition: The strongest brief increases in wind speed measured or expected

examples.en: The map showed where peak wind gusts were expected that afternoon.
examples.zh: 地图显示了当天午后哪些地方预计会出现「最强阵风」。

examples.en: I compared the peak wind gusts in two updates from the forecaster.
examples.zh: 我比较了预报机构两次更新里的「最强阵风」。

collocations: a map of peak wind gusts

words.enDefinition: Conditions making it harder to see over normal distances

examples.en: The bus update mentioned reduced visibility near the river crossing.
examples.zh: 公交动态提到过河路段附近「能见度下降」。

examples.en: The weather report showed where reduced visibility was expected after dark.
examples.zh: 天气报告标出了天黑后哪些地方预计会「能见度下降」。

words.enDefinition: Flooding occurring in particular places rather than across an entire area

examples.en: The council reported localized flooding on two streets near campus.
examples.zh: 市政部门报告说，学校附近有两条街出现「局部淹水」。

examples.en: The bus operator blamed localized flooding for the diversion near the sports centre.
examples.zh: 公交运营方说，体育中心附近改道是因为出现了「局部淹水」。

words.enDefinition: A prediction of how high the water in a river will be

examples.en: The river level forecast showed a rise near our fieldwork site.
examples.zh: 「河流水位预报」显示实地考察地点附近水位将上涨。

examples.en: I found the river level forecast beside the map of local roads.
examples.zh: 我在本地道路地图旁找到了「河流水位预报」。

words.enDefinition: Water covering normally dry land along a coast

examples.en: The council map marked areas at risk of coastal inundation.
examples.zh: 市议会的地图标出了可能发生「沿海淹水」的地区。

examples.en: The notice linked the port closure to expected coastal inundation.
examples.zh: 通知说，港口关闭与预计出现的「沿海淹水」有关。

words.enDefinition: The formation of ice on a paved road surface

examples.en: The shuttle operator reported road icing along the riverside route.
examples.zh: 班车运营方报告说，临河线路发生了「道路结冰」。

examples.en: The forecast highlighted a risk of road icing after dark.
examples.zh: 预报特别指出，天黑后可能出现「道路结冰」。

words.enDefinition: Branches that have fallen from trees and may obstruct routes

examples.en: The park notice mentioned fallen branches on the northern path.
examples.zh: 公园通知说北边小路上有「掉落的树枝」。

examples.en: The campus crew listed fallen branches in its grounds report.
examples.zh: 校园维护人员在场地报告中列出了「掉落的树枝」。

words.enDefinition: A closure of a place or facility because of weather

examples.en: The museum announced a weather-related closure through its local newsletter.
examples.zh: 博物馆通过本地简报宣布「因天气暂停开放」。

examples.en: I read the weather-related closure notice before heading to the sports centre.
examples.zh: 去体育中心之前，我看了「因天气暂停开放」的通知。

words.enDefinition: An announcement or arrangement to open later than originally scheduled

examples.en: The district announced a delayed opening for its public library.
examples.zh: 该地区宣布公共图书馆将「推迟开放」。

examples.en: The delayed opening appeared in a message about overnight ice.
examples.zh: 关于夜间结冰的消息里提到了「推迟开放」。

words.enDefinition: To return to the usual schedule after a disruption

examples.en: The library said it would resume normal hours the following day.
examples.zh: 图书馆说，第二天会「恢复正常开放时间」。

examples.en: I checked when the sports centre planned to resume normal hours.
examples.zh: 我查了体育中心计划什么时候「恢复正常开放时间」。

collocations: announce when to resume normal hours

words.enDefinition: An arrangement keeping part of a site closed and part open

examples.en: The city posted a partial closure for the park after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨后，市政府公布公园「部分区域关闭」。

examples.en: I read what the partial closure meant for the sports fields.
examples.zh: 我查看了「部分区域关闭」对运动场有什么影响。

collocations: a notice about a partial closure
a partial closure of the grounds

words.enDefinition: Interruption of normal activities or services caused by a storm

examples.en: The council listed storm disruption separately from its regular maintenance.
examples.zh: 市议会把「风暴造成的服务中断」与常规维护分开列出。

examples.en: The local notice listed the services affected by storm disruption that morning.
examples.zh: 本地通知列出了当日上午受「风暴造成的服务中断」影响的服务。

words.enDefinition: A road partly or fully covered by flood water

examples.en: The bus company named a flooded road in its service update.
examples.zh: 公交公司在更新中点明了一条「被洪水淹没的道路」。

examples.en: I saw a flooded road marked beside the main junction.
examples.zh: 我看到主路口旁标了一条「被洪水淹没的道路」。

collocations: a route affected by a flooded road
a map showing a flooded road

words.enDefinition: A status indicating a road cannot currently be used for travel

examples.en: The county map showed "Road impassable" beside the riverside road.
examples.zh: 县里的地图在临河道路旁显示「道路无法通行」。

examples.en: I asked which section was marked "Road impassable" that evening.
examples.zh: 我问当晚哪一段路被标记为「道路无法通行」。

collocations: a map entry reading road impassable

words.enDefinition: A temporary stopping of access to a bridge

examples.en: The bus operator displayed the bridge closure beside its route map.
examples.zh: 公交运营方在路线图旁显示了「大桥封闭」信息。

examples.en: The council marked the bridge closure on both sides of the river.
examples.zh: 市议会在河两岸标出了「大桥封闭」的位置。

collocations: a notice about a bridge closure

words.enDefinition: Damage where flowing water removes part of a roadway

examples.en: The local update linked the route closure to a road washout.
examples.zh: 本地动态说，线路封闭是因为「道路被水冲毁」。

examples.en: The council map marked the location of the road washout.
examples.zh: 市议会地图标出了「道路被水冲毁」的位置。

collocations: a route affected by a road washout

words.enDefinition: A tree that has fallen, often during severe weather

examples.en: The road notice named a downed tree near the junction.
examples.zh: 道路通知提到路口附近有一棵「倒下的树」。

examples.en: The college listed a downed tree in its report on access.
examples.zh: 学院的通行情况报告中列出了一棵「倒下的树」。

collocations: a road blocked by a downed tree

words.enDefinition: Branches or other loose material left behind by a storm

examples.en: The park report listed storm debris on some of its paths.
examples.zh: 公园报告说，部分小路上有「风暴遗留的杂物」。

examples.en: The council said storm debris was affecting access to the gardens.
examples.zh: 市议会说，「风暴遗留的杂物」影响了进入花园的通道。

collocations: a route blocked by storm debris

words.enDefinition: The clearing away of material blocking a route or site

examples.en: The grounds team posted a notice about debris removal near campus.
examples.zh: 场地管理团队张贴了学校附近「杂物清理」的通知。

examples.en: The road reopened after debris removal was completed that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午「杂物清理」完成后，道路重新开放。

words.enDefinition: An official check of damage to places or equipment after a storm

examples.en: The city posted a storm damage assessment before updating the park schedule.
examples.zh: 市政府在更新公园开放安排前发布了「风暴灾损评估」。

examples.en: The crew mentioned its storm damage assessment in the afternoon bulletin.
examples.zh: 维护团队在下午公报中提到了他们的「风暴灾损评估」。

collocations: carry out a storm damage assessment
results of a storm damage assessment

words.enDefinition: Water flowing out of a drain meant to carry rainfall away

examples.en: The city reported a storm drain overflow beside the busiest junction.
examples.zh: 市政府报告说，最繁忙的路口旁出现了「雨水排水口溢流」。

examples.en: The road notice mentioned storm drain overflow after several hours of rain.
examples.zh: 连续下了几个小时雨后，道路通知提到了「雨水排水口溢流」。

collocations: a notice about storm drain overflow
an area affected by storm drain overflow

words.enDefinition: Rainwater flowing across land or pavement after falling

examples.en: The report showed where stormwater runoff had reached the nearby path.
examples.zh: 报告显示了「雨水地表径流」是从哪里流到附近小路的。

examples.en: The council's map identified areas affected by stormwater runoff near campus.
examples.zh: 市议会地图标出了学校附近受「雨水地表径流」影响的区域。

words.enDefinition: Ground holding so much water that it stays saturated

examples.en: The sports centre cited waterlogged ground in its field closure notice.
examples.zh: 体育中心在球场关闭通知中提到了「严重积水的地面」。

examples.en: I read that waterlogged ground was affecting the route beside the river.
examples.zh: 我看到消息说，「严重积水的地面」影响了河边的线路。

collocations: close a path due to waterlogged ground

words.enDefinition: A temporary stop in a ferry's regular service

examples.en: The port announced a ferry suspension after the wind warning.
examples.zh: 港口在强风警告后宣布「渡轮暂停运营」。

examples.en: The ferry suspension was posted above the usual weekend timetable.
examples.zh: 「渡轮暂停运营」的公告贴在常规周末时刻表上面。

collocations: a notice about a ferry suspension

words.enDefinition: Sea conditions with large or irregular waves and movement

examples.en: The ferry operator cited rough seas in its latest timetable update.
examples.zh: 渡轮运营方在时刻表最新动态里提到「海面风浪大」。

examples.en: I read the message about rough seas near the harbor.
examples.zh: 我读了关于港湾附近「海面风浪大」的消息。

collocations: a crossing cancelled due to rough seas

words.enDefinition: The removal of snow from roads or other public surfaces

examples.en: The council posted the snow clearance schedule after the overnight storm.
examples.zh: 夜间风暴过后，市议会公布了「清除积雪」的安排。

examples.en: The bus notice mentioned snow clearance near the central station.
examples.zh: 公交通知提到中央车站附近正在「清除积雪」。

words.enDefinition: Work applied to road surfaces to manage snow or ice

examples.en: The local bulletin listed road treatment for the main roads overnight.
examples.zh: 本地公报列出了夜间对主要道路进行「道路防冰处理」的安排。

examples.en: The update showed where road treatment was already complete that morning.
examples.zh: 更新显示当天早上哪些地方已经完成「道路防冰处理」。

collocations: work crews carrying out road treatment

words.enDefinition: A later than scheduled collection of household or public waste

examples.en: The council posted a waste collection delay for the streets near the river.
examples.zh: 市议会发布了河边街区「垃圾收运延迟」的通知。

examples.en: I checked whether the waste collection delay affected our student residence.
examples.zh: 我查了这次「垃圾收运延迟」是否影响我们宿舍。

collocations: a notice about a waste collection delay
areas with a waste collection delay

words.enDefinition: A status showing a site can offer only some usual services

examples.en: The city office said it had limited on-site services that afternoon.
examples.zh: 市政府办事处说，当天下午「仅提供部分现场服务」。

examples.en: The library listed limited on-site services because some equipment was unavailable.
examples.zh: 由于有些设备无法使用，图书馆写明「仅提供部分现场服务」。

collocations: a notice of limited on-site services

words.enDefinition: A label indicating an outdoor place is temporarily unavailable

examples.en: The event page showed "Outdoor venue closed" after the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 强降雨后，活动页面显示「室外场地关闭」。

examples.en: I saw "Outdoor venue closed" beside the field marked on the map.
examples.zh: 我在地图所标的运动场旁看到「室外场地关闭」。

collocations: a notice saying outdoor venue closed
an event page marked outdoor venue closed
show outdoor venue closed on the map

words.enDefinition: New information about when or how a closed place will reopen

examples.en: The reopening update gave the latest hours for the park entrance.
examples.zh: 「重新开放动态」公布了公园入口最新的开放时间。

examples.en: I saved the reopening update before checking the new bus timetable.
examples.zh: 我先存了「重新开放动态」，再看新的公交时刻表。

collocations: a reopening update from the council

words.enDefinition: A notice indicating that entry into an area is limited

examples.en: The map showed "Access restricted" beside the path leading to the bridge.
examples.zh: 地图在通往大桥的小路旁显示「通行受限」。

examples.en: I checked which gate the notice marked "Access restricted" that morning.
examples.zh: 我查了当天早上通知把哪个门标为「通行受限」。

words.enDefinition: A public place identified for people to use during dangerous cold

examples.en: The council map listed one designated warming centre near the university.
examples.zh: 市议会的地图在大学附近列出了一处「指定取暖中心」。

examples.en: The notice gave the hours of the designated warming centre for that week.
examples.zh: 通知列明了「指定取暖中心」那一周的开放时间。

collocations: a map of a designated warming centre
a notice naming a designated warming centre

words.enDefinition: A public facility made available for relief from severe heat

examples.en: The city included a cooling centre on its summer information map.
examples.zh: 市政府在夏季信息地图上标出了一处「避暑纳凉中心」。

examples.en: I checked when the cooling centre would be open that weekend.
examples.zh: 我查看了「避暑纳凉中心」那个周末的开放时间。

collocations: the hours of a cooling centre

words.enDefinition: An announcement about the availability of facilities used by the public

examples.en: The council linked to its public facilities update below the storm notice.
examples.zh: 市议会在风暴通知下附上了「公共设施开放动态」的链接。

examples.en: I checked the public facilities update for changes to sports centre hours.
examples.zh: 我查看了「公共设施开放动态」，确认体育中心的时间是否有变动。

words.enDefinition: An interruption of utility service that was not scheduled

examples.en: The utility posted a notice about an unplanned outage downtown.
examples.zh: 公用服务机构发布了市区「非计划性停运」的通知。

examples.en: I checked whether our street was included in the unplanned outage.
examples.zh: 我查了一下，我们这条街是否在「非计划性停运」的范围内。

collocations: a notice of an unplanned outage
an area affected by an unplanned outage

words.enDefinition: A service interruption that recurs between periods of availability

examples.en: The notice described an intermittent outage rather than a continuous interruption.
examples.zh: 通知介绍的是「时断时续的停运」，中间有时还能使用服务。

examples.en: Our street appeared in the update about the intermittent outage.
examples.zh: 我们这条街出现在「时断时续的停运」动态中。

collocations: a notice about an intermittent outage
customers affected by an intermittent outage

words.enDefinition: A loss of electricity affecting only some parts of a location

examples.en: The hall manager reported a partial power outage in our building.
examples.zh: 宿舍管理员报告说我们楼内有「部分区域停电」。

examples.en: The notice explained which floors had a partial power outage that morning.
examples.zh: 通知说明了当天早上哪些楼层出现「部分区域停电」。

collocations: a building affected by a partial power outage
updates about a partial power outage

words.enDefinition: A planned series of temporary electricity interruptions in different areas

examples.en: The provider used the term rolling blackout in its public update.
examples.zh: 供电方在公开动态中用了「轮流停电」这个词。

examples.en: I checked which areas the rolling blackout notice named on the map.
examples.zh: 我核对了「轮流停电」通知在地图上列出的区域。

collocations: areas affected by a rolling blackout

words.enDefinition: A disruption affecting a large area or many service users

examples.en: The operator described a widespread outage in its morning service notice.
examples.zh: 运营方在早间服务通知中介绍了「大范围停运」的情况。

examples.en: The local bulletin linked the widespread outage to the overnight storm.
examples.zh: 本地公报说，「大范围停运」与夜间的风暴有关。

collocations: customers affected by a widespread outage

words.enDefinition: An overhead electricity line that has fallen from its position

examples.en: The provider reported a downed power line near the closed road.
examples.zh: 供电方报告说，封闭道路附近有一根「掉落的电线」。

examples.en: The bus update listed a detour because of a downed power line.
examples.zh: 公交运营方在动态中说明，因「掉落的电线」要改道。

collocations: a report of a downed power line
a road closed due to a downed power line
a notice about a downed power line

words.enDefinition: Damage to a pole carrying power or communication lines

examples.en: The provider mentioned utility pole damage in the evening outage update.
examples.zh: 服务商在晚间停运动态中提到了「电线杆受损」。

examples.en: The report showed where utility pole damage had been recorded after the storm.
examples.zh: 报告标出了风暴过后哪些地方记录到「电线杆受损」。

collocations: a notice about utility pole damage

words.enDefinition: A problem affecting equipment that changes voltage in an electricity supply

examples.en: The utility listed a transformer fault as the cause of the interruption.
examples.zh: 供电机构把「变压器故障」列为供电中断的原因。

examples.en: The evening notice included an update about the transformer fault near campus.
examples.zh: 晚间通知更新了学校附近「变压器故障」的情况。

collocations: an outage caused by a transformer fault

words.enDefinition: A status indicating a repair team has been sent to a site

examples.en: The outage map showed "Crew dispatched" for our part of town.
examples.zh: 停运地图把我们所在城区标为「已派出维修人员」。

examples.en: I saw "Crew dispatched" below the entry for the affected street.
examples.zh: 我在受影响街道的条目下面看到了「已派出维修人员」。

collocations: a utility map marked crew dispatched
an outage update saying crew dispatched

words.enDefinition: A status indicating a team has arrived at the work location

examples.en: The utility update showed "Crew on site" next to the location.
examples.zh: 公用服务机构在地点旁显示「维修人员已到现场」。

examples.en: I checked when the update first said "Crew on site" that afternoon.
examples.zh: 我查了当天下午的动态最早什么时候显示「维修人员已到现场」。

collocations: a status reading crew on site
a notice saying crew on site
an outage report marked crew on site

words.enDefinition: A status indicating the cause of a fault is being examined

examples.en: The provider showed "Fault under investigation" rather than listing a cause.
examples.zh: 供电方显示「故障正在调查中」，原因一栏暂时为空。

examples.en: The message "Fault under investigation" was posted early that morning.
examples.zh: 「故障正在调查中」的消息是那天一早发的。

collocations: a notice saying fault under investigation
a case marked fault under investigation
an update reading fault under investigation

words.enDefinition: The predicted time when a disrupted service may return

examples.en: The estimated restoration time changed between the morning and evening notices.
examples.zh: 早间和晚间通知中的「预计恢复时间」不同。

examples.en: I asked whether the estimated restoration time applied to our street.
examples.zh: 我问「预计恢复时间」是否适用于我们的街道。

words.enDefinition: A status saying no recovery time can currently be provided

examples.en: The page said "Restoration estimate unavailable" beneath the affected area map.
examples.zh: 页面在受影响区域的地图下显示「暂无预计恢复时间」。

examples.en: I saw "Restoration estimate unavailable" before the revised time was posted.
examples.zh: 我在调整后的时间发布前看到「暂无预计恢复时间」。

collocations: a notice reading restoration estimate unavailable
a map marked restoration estimate unavailable
an outage status of restoration estimate unavailable

words.enDefinition: A status indicating work to return a service has begun

examples.en: The utility map showed "Restoration in progress" for several nearby streets.
examples.zh: 公用服务机构地图把附近几条街标为「服务正在恢复」。

examples.en: The second update said "Restoration in progress" under the service heading.
examples.zh: 第二条动态在服务标题下写着「服务正在恢复」。

collocations: a notice reading restoration in progress
a map marked restoration in progress
an outage update saying restoration in progress

words.enDefinition: Words indicating a service will take longer to return than expected

examples.en: The update said "Restoration delayed" and gave a new estimate.
examples.zh: 动态说「服务恢复延后」，并给出了新的预计时间。

examples.en: I read "Restoration delayed" next to the latest reported fault.
examples.zh: 我在最新报告的故障旁看到了「服务恢复延后」。

collocations: a service status saying restoration delayed

words.enDefinition: Words indicating electricity is available again after an interruption

examples.en: The provider marked our street "Power restored" after the repair.
examples.zh: 修复后，供电方把我们这条街标为「供电已恢复」。

examples.en: I saw "Power restored" listed next to the student residence.
examples.zh: 我看到学生公寓旁写着「供电已恢复」。

collocations: a service notice reading power restored

words.enDefinition: A status indicating the reported repair work is finished

examples.en: The latest bulletin said "Repairs complete" for the affected road.
examples.zh: 最新公报把受影响道路标为「维修已完成」。

examples.en: The provider sent "Repairs complete" as an update about our building.
examples.zh: 服务商发来一条有关我们这栋楼的更新，写着「维修已完成」。

words.enDefinition: An update saying service has returned for only some affected customers

examples.en: The utility said power was restored to some customers in the eastern district.
examples.zh: 供电机构表示，东部辖区的「部分用户已恢复供电」。

examples.en: I read that service was restored to some customers after the first repair.
examples.zh: 我看到消息说，第一轮维修后「部分用户服务已恢复」。

collocations: an update saying restored to some customers

words.enDefinition: A break in a main pipe distributing water to an area

examples.en: The utility cited a water main break in its street notice.
examples.zh: 供水机构在街区通知中提到了「供水主管破裂」。

examples.en: I checked which road was affected by the water main break.
examples.zh: 我查了「供水主管破裂」影响了哪条路。

collocations: a street affected by a water main break
repairs after a water main break

words.enDefinition: A drop in the pressure pushing water through supply pipes

examples.en: The provider reported a loss of water pressure across the east district.
examples.zh: 供水方报告称，东部辖区出现了「水压下降」。

examples.en: The notice described a loss of water pressure after the main pipe broke.
examples.zh: 通知描述了供水主管破裂后出现的「水压下降」。

collocations: report a loss of water pressure
an area affected by loss of water pressure
a notice about loss of water pressure

words.enDefinition: A supply of water that stops and returns repeatedly

examples.en: The provider listed intermittent water supply in its update for our street.
examples.zh: 供水方在我们这条街的动态中注明「供水时断时续」。

examples.en: The building notice mentioned intermittent water supply during the afternoon repairs.
examples.zh: 大楼通知提到，下午维修期间「供水时断时续」。

collocations: a notice about intermittent water supply

words.enDefinition: A status indicating water is available again after an interruption

examples.en: The update showed "Water supply restored" for the university neighborhood.
examples.zh: 动态把学校附近标为「供水已恢复」。

examples.en: We saw "Water supply restored" next to the earlier outage notice.
examples.zh: 我们在先前的停水通知旁看到了「供水已恢复」。

collocations: a status reading water supply restored
a message saying water supply restored
a map marked water supply restored

words.enDefinition: An official notice that drinking water requires boiling before use

examples.en: The utility posted a boil water advisory on its official website.
examples.zh: 供水机构在其官网发布了「饮用水煮沸通告」。

examples.en: I checked which district the boil water advisory referred to in the notice.
examples.zh: 我核对了通知中的「饮用水煮沸通告」指的是哪个区。

collocations: an area under a boil water advisory

words.enDefinition: An official notice that supplied water is unsuitable for drinking

examples.en: The utility included a do not drink advisory in its morning bulletin.
examples.zh: 供水机构在早间公报中发布了「自来水禁饮通告」。

examples.en: I checked the affected streets listed in the do not drink advisory.
examples.zh: 我查看了「自来水禁饮通告」列出的受影响街道。

collocations: issue a do not drink advisory
an area under a do not drink advisory
lift a do not drink advisory

words.enDefinition: an official notice telling people not to use the affected tap water

examples.en: The utility page showed a do not use advisory for the affected zone.
examples.zh: 供水机构的网页为受影响区域发布了「禁止使用自来水通告」。

examples.en: The do not use advisory appeared separately from the earlier water update.
examples.zh: 「禁止使用自来水通告」与早先的供水动态分开显示。

collocations: issue a do not use advisory
areas under a do not use advisory
lift a do not use advisory

words.enDefinition: Words indicating a water advisory formally no longer applies

examples.en: The utility posted "Water advisory lifted" after publishing the test results.
examples.zh: 供水机构公布检测结果后发布了「用水通告已解除」。

examples.en: I saw "Water advisory lifted" on the public water service page.
examples.zh: 我在公共供水服务页面上看到「用水通告已解除」。

collocations: a notice saying water advisory lifted
an area marked water advisory lifted
a water service update reading water advisory lifted

words.enDefinition: The examination of water samples for quality or possible contamination

examples.en: The utility released a short report on water quality testing that morning.
examples.zh: 供水机构当天上午发布了一份「水质检测」简报。

examples.en: The update gave a separate date for water quality testing near campus.
examples.zh: 更新为学校附近的「水质检测」单独列了日期。

collocations: a notice about water quality testing

words.enDefinition: Tap water that has a visibly different colour than usual

examples.en: The water company mentioned discoloured tap water in its neighborhood notice.
examples.zh: 供水公司在社区通知中提到了「颜色异常的自来水」。

examples.en: I checked which streets reported discoloured tap water after the repair.
examples.zh: 我查了维修后哪些街道报告有「颜色异常的自来水」。

collocations: an update about discoloured tap water
a notice referring to discoloured tap water

words.enDefinition: A substitute water source provided during an interruption

examples.en: The council bulletin described an alternative water supply for the district.
examples.zh: 市议会在公报中介绍了该地区的「临时替代供水」。

examples.en: I checked which location the notice listed for the alternative water supply.
examples.zh: 我查了通知上列出的「临时替代供水」地点。

collocations: details of an alternative water supply
a notice about an alternative water supply

words.enDefinition: A location where a utility or agency provides substitute water

examples.en: The council map showed a water distribution point near the park.
examples.zh: 市议会地图在公园附近标了一个「临时供水点」。

examples.en: The bulletin listed the hours of the water distribution point downtown.
examples.zh: 公报列出了市中心「临时供水点」的开放时间。

collocations: a map of a water distribution point

words.enDefinition: A period during which supplied gas is unavailable to users

examples.en: The provider issued a notice about a gas service interruption downtown.
examples.zh: 供气方发布了市区「供气中断」的通知。

examples.en: I checked whether our building was affected by the gas service interruption.
examples.zh: 我查了我们大楼是否受到「供气中断」的影响。

collocations: a notice about a gas service interruption
updates during a gas service interruption

words.enDefinition: A disruption of cellular services in one or more areas

examples.en: The carrier's update confirmed a mobile network outage near campus.
examples.zh: 运营商在更新中确认学校附近有「移动通信网络中断」。

examples.en: I read that the mobile network outage affected calls in several neighborhoods.
examples.zh: 我读到消息说，「移动通信网络中断」影响了几个街区的通话。

collocations: a notice about a mobile network outage
areas affected by a mobile network outage

words.enDefinition: An alternative electricity supply used during a loss of regular power

examples.en: The library said its lights were running on backup power.
examples.zh: 图书馆说，照明正在用「备用电源」供电。

examples.en: The building notice explained which facilities had backup power that morning.
examples.zh: 大楼的通知说明了当天早上哪些设施有「备用电源」。

words.enDefinition: Workers assigned to restore equipment used for public utility services

examples.en: The notice mentioned a utility repair crew working beside the road.
examples.zh: 通知提到一支「公用设施维修队」正在路边工作。

examples.en: The provider confirmed that a utility repair crew had reached our building.
examples.zh: 服务商确认，一支「公用设施维修队」已经到了我们楼。

collocations: a utility repair crew on site
updates from a utility repair crew

words.enDefinition: An update saying a weather warning now covers more places

examples.en: The bulletin said "Warning area expanded" and linked to a revised map.
examples.zh: 公报写着「警告区域已扩大」，并附上了更新后的地图链接。

examples.en: I saw "Warning area expanded" in the county's latest weather notice.
examples.zh: 我在县里最新的天气通知中看到「警告区域已扩大」。

collocations: a notice reading warning area expanded
an alert marked warning area expanded
a map update saying warning area expanded

words.enDefinition: An interruption leaving street lighting unavailable in a particular area

examples.en: The city listed a streetlight outage outside the library entrance.
examples.zh: 市政府列出了图书馆入口外的「路灯停电」。

examples.en: The notice said the streetlight outage affected both sides of the street.
examples.zh: 通知说，这次「路灯停电」影响了街道两侧。

collocations: a notice about a streetlight outage
an area affected by a streetlight outage

words.enDefinition: A notice saying traffic signals are not currently working

examples.en: The traffic update read "Traffic signals out" beside the junction near campus.
examples.zh: 交通动态在学校附近的路口旁写着「交通信号灯停用」。

examples.en: I saw "Traffic signals out" on the map after the power failure.
examples.zh: 供电中断后，我在地图上看到了「交通信号灯停用」。

collocations: a notice reading traffic signals out
an intersection marked traffic signals out
a report saying traffic signals out

words.enDefinition: Amounts of rain measured over a stated period in different places

examples.en: The report showed different rainfall totals for the northern and southern districts.
examples.zh: 报告列出了北区和南区不同的「累计降雨量」。

examples.en: I checked which period the rainfall totals covered in that bulletin.
examples.zh: 我查了那份公报的「累计降雨量」涵盖哪个时段。
